title: Michael confirms the UFO in the first phone call
place_text: November 5 missile site, Ellsworth AFB, South Dakota

plain: A former Air Force man named Michael Johnson says that when he first got back in touch by phone with Mario Woods, a fellow veteran, he confirmed seeing the UFO they both say appeared in 1977 at a nuclear missile site called November 5, near Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota. Johnson tells it himself on the show, where the two men reunite, recalling: "It was big though. I remember. We saw it. It was white." It matters because it backs up Woods's memory of the night.
